title: Topcoat: The full full-stack framework for Rust
summary: Topcoat is a new full-stack Rust framework developed under the tokio-rs ecosystem, enabling developers to build both frontend and backend applications entirely in Rust with potential WebAssembly compilation for the client-side.
problem_solved: Enables end-to-end type-safe full-stack development in a single language, allowing code sharing between frontend and backend.
why_valuable: Provides the ability to build high-performance web applications with Rust's memory safety guarantees across the entire stack while maximizing code reuse between client and server.
